about_the_game:
In this dark romance visual novel, you are asteroid dT, orbiting the celestials of Ananke System and trying to understand yourself and what you want, or will tolerate, in a relationship.

Your choices shape who dT becomes and what celestials she meets.

In the demo, there are 2 complete routes, and several that lead to the cliffhanger. Ananke System holds one potential romance, but the full game includes 3 more. Each romance can end in happiness... or darkness.

🪐 Full Game Features

  • A romantasy visual novel where planets, suns, and asteroids long for connection

  • Branching storylines with multiple routes, endings, and hidden paths

  • Tragic first loves in Ananke System, followed by three new romances in Thallo

  • Emotional storytelling, rich character dynamics, and the freedom to choose love… or drift away

Jupiter's Orbit is a choice-driven romantasy visual novel/dating sim.

name: Jupiter's Orbit Demo
short_description: A branching narrative, visual novel dating sim where you play asteroid dT. The demo is limited to the first solar system, Ananke, and includes 1 of 4 loves, some early hints to astrological secrets, and 2 full routes. Jupiter’s Orbit has multiple endings based on your choices.
